beat_layers_vs_audio.finding: The 14-frame in-puppet beat grid sits ~6 frames (about half a beat) off the measured audio grid and drifts ~0.6 frames per beat (14.0 vs true 13.4). It tracks the off-beat side of the pulse. Reading: a counting aid drawn against the layout movie, not a frame-lock to the final track — the pose keyframes carry the true sync (twist starts within 0.4 frames of an accent).
beat_layers_vs_audio.masami_beat_layer: Spans alternate 11/10 frames (avg 10.5 = ~143 BPM). Matches neither grid. Her puppet is a GB200 series library asset; the layer is a leftover from the library build, not this scene's tempo.

levels.reading: These are animation-stage working mixes (hot, flat, mono), not broadcast masters. Final loudness is set in post-production.

swf_sound_stream_blocks.note: exactly one stream block per frame

per_shot_track.swf_publish_format: MP3 stream at 11025 Hz (Flash publish compression of the AIFF)

spectrum.reading: Sc057 is bass-led (59% of energy under 250 Hz). Sc059 is mid-forward and far more tonal (80% pitched frames) — a closer, duller bed under the close-up.

tempo.cut_continuity: NOT phase-continuous: a single uncut song would put Sc059's grid at phase ~6.7; measured ~3.3. Each shot was delivered its own cut of the track.
tempo.phrase_note: phrase accents = every 4 beats = 2.16 s; each is preceded ~6 frames (half a beat) by a pickup hit

format.units: frames are scene frames at 25 fps; positions/sizes in authoring pixels unless marked puppet units

match_these_numbers_for_cape_jones.approach_shot: lock the scene placement; scale parts inside the puppet (head x2.3 over the shot) for a x10 screen-area growth
match_these_numbers_for_cape_jones.audio_to_animation: one mono breakdown track per shot, exactly the shot's frame count, delivered before animation; animation keys to it; final mix and loudness happen in post
match_these_numbers_for_cape_jones.background_cast_pose_changes_per_sec: 6-8, bursty, with dead holds up to ~2.8 s
match_these_numbers_for_cape_jones.keyframing: on twos by default (83-92% of keyframes); ones only for accent hits (~2%)
match_these_numbers_for_cape_jones.music: ~112 BPM; beat = 13.4 frames; phrase accent every 4 beats (~54 frames); signature moves start ON accents (within half a frame)

movement.background_critters_sc057: Symbols c1-c10 (drawn background characters on '3d character ref' / Layer 6-13 scene layers): 7 keyframes each across 198 frames = a new pose roughly every 28 frames (~0.9/s).
movement.carrie_hover_sc057: Scene-level: 10 keyframes, placement ty 354.75 -> 337.35 (rises 17.4 px over 198 frames, ~2.2 px/s) on motion tweens with 22-34-frame holds — a slow ghost hover, animated at scene level while her puppet animates internally.

darwin_approach_sc057.reading: Screen area grows x10.3 across the shot. The approach is manufactured inside the puppet by scaling the parts up (head comp x2.32) while the scene placement stays locked.
darwin_approach_sc057.scene_placement: static for all 198 frames (scale -0.366 = flipped, tx 1089.4, ty 544.65) — the symbol never moves in the scene

definitions.authored_pose_change: a frame where at least one drawing layer of the puppet starts a new keyframe state (new part placement / drawing swap / transform). Counted from authored keyframes only — symbol loop playback is not counted as new drawings.
definitions.drawings_per_second: authored pose changes per second of scene time (the puppet-production equivalent of drawings/sec)

twist_layer_sc059.reading: Held 43 frames, then 27 keyframes on strict twos (frames 43-97 = 12.5 poses/s on this layer), then a 1f/3f/1f exit and an 11-frame hold-out.

sources: FLA internal media stores (bin/*.dat) — original per-shot AIFF PCM
study: Production science — Gumball 'The Words' (GB214) Sc057 + Sc059
